description: A beige box that hums like it's grinding its teeth. The compressor cycles every four minutes whether anything's inside or not, and the door seal gave up its ambitions years ago — held shut now by a strip of gaffer tape and pure spite. No logo, no serial plate, no warranty. Just cold, allegedly.
name: Coldbox Refrigeration Unit
